::: {.bnr-manual-flag .bnr-manual-flag--technical}
Technical Manual
:::

## What this step does

Mortality Step 5 records authorised human approval of the exact files reviewed in Step 4. It checks that those files have not changed, creates the private `public_ready` folder and writes the approval record last.

`public_ready` means the files are authorised for Step 6 to publish. It does not mean they are already public.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Procedure at a glance"}
1. Complete the Step 4 human review.
2. Enter the approver’s name and authorised role.
3. Confirm all five review statements.
4. Run Step 5 and confirm `APPROVED - PENDING STEP 6`.
5. Check `approval.yml`, `public_manifest.csv` and the ten authorised files.
:::

## Before you start

- Complete Step 4 review for the same year and month.
- Stop if any of the five confirmation statements is not true.
- Use an authorised **BNR Lead** or **BNR Analyst** approver. BNR decides which people holding these roles may approve dissemination.

Step 5 checks the generated file list and checksums in `mort_s4_review_basis_mort_YYYY_MM.csv`. A checksum is a value used to detect whether a reviewed file has changed.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Input and review files"}

Step 5 reads the complete Step 3 package and these Step 4 files from `$BNR_STAGING/mortality/burden/mort_YYYY_MM/review/`.

| File | What Step 5 uses or checks |
|---|---|
| **`mort_s4_review_mort_YYYY_MM.xlsx` — Review this first** | Evidence of the completed human review. Step 5 confirms the file is unchanged; the approver confirms the review was satisfactory. |
| `mort_s4_candidate.dta` | Private proposed public data that Step 5 converts into the authorised publication files. |
| `mort_s4_review_qa_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Step 4 automated-check results. |
| `mort_s4_review_basis_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Exact file list, sizes and checksums recorded by Step 4. |
| `mort_s4_monthly_reference_2015_2019.dta` | Proposed fixed monthly reference in Stata format. |
| `mort_s4_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv` | CSV copy of the proposed fixed monthly reference. |
| `mort_s4_monthly_reference_2015_2019.yml` | Generated description and control status for the proposed reference. |

Step 5 also rechecks the Step 3 data, metadata, automated-check files, suppression worklist and `readme.txt` listed on the Step 4 page.

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Code files"}

| File | How it is used |
|---|---|
| `scripts/stata/mortality/bnr_mort_s5_approve.do` | Main Step 5 controller; checks the reviewed files and creates the approval evidence and authorised files. |
| `scripts/stata/dialogs/bnr_mort_s5_approve.dlg` | Preferred routine route because it displays all five confirmation statements. |
| `scripts/stata/menu/bnr_menu.do` | Adds Step 5 to the BNR Stata menu. |

:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Output files"}

Step 5 creates `$BNR_STAGING/mortality/burden/mort_YYYY_MM/public_ready/`. All files remain private until Step 6.

| File | What it contains |
|---|---|
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.dta` | Authorised data-release mortality measures in Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.csv` | Authorised CSV copy of the data-release measures. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.dta` | Authorised stable-name mortality measures in Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_burden_metrics_current.csv` | Authorised stable-name CSV copy. |
| `datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.dta` | Authorised fixed monthly reference in Stata format. |
| `datasets/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.csv` | Authorised CSV copy of the fixed monthly reference. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_metrics_mort_YYYY_MM.yml` | Generated description of the data-release measures. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_metrics_current.yml` | Generated description of the stable-name measures. |
| `metadata/mort_burden_package.yml` | Generated description of the complete public data package. |
| `metadata/mort_monthly_reference_2015_2019.yml` | Generated description of the approved fixed monthly reference. |
| `public_manifest.csv` | Private generated list of the exact ten files Step 6 is allowed to publish, with their sizes and checksums. |
| `approval.yml` | Private approval record. It is written last and says publication remains pending Step 6. |
| `$BNR_PRIVATE_LOGS/bnr_mort_s5_approve_mort_YYYY_MM.log` | Private run log. |

:::

## Approve the data package

1. In Stata, choose **User > BNR > Update CVD mortality dashboard > Step 5: Approve reviewed mortality release**.
2. Enter the reviewed year and month, the approver’s full name and the authorised role.
3. Confirm that you checked:

   - the data release and reporting period;
   - definitions and results;
   - disclosure control;
   - the proposed public data and review workbook; and
   - publication readiness, including the monthly reference.

4. Select **Record approval**.
5. Alternatively, enter the complete routine command in the **Stata command window**:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/mortality/bnr_mort_s5_approve.do" ///
       2026 7 "Full name" "BNR Analyst" ///
       release definitions disclosure candidate ready
   ```

6. For a deliberate replacement of an existing Step 5 approval, enter the complete replacement command:

   ```stata
   do "$BNR_STATA/mortality/bnr_mort_s5_approve.do" ///
       2026 7 "Full name" "BNR Analyst" ///
       release definitions disclosure candidate ready replace
   ```

7. In `MORTALITY STEP 5: OPERATIONAL RUN SUMMARY`, confirm `Run status: APPROVED - PENDING STEP 6`.
8. Open `public_ready/approval.yml` and confirm the data release, approver, role, disclosure status and publication status are correct.
9. Open `public_ready/public_manifest.csv` and confirm it lists exactly the ten dataset and metadata files described above.
10. Confirm all ten authorised files exist. Do not edit any file in `public_ready/`.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="If Step 5 does not complete"}

| Situation | Action |
|---|---|
| A Step 4 file has changed since review | Rerun Step 4 and repeat the human review. Do not approve a file different from the one reviewed. |
| A confirmation cannot truthfully be made | Stop and return to the relevant review or earlier workflow step. |
| An existing approval blocks an authorised replacement | Repeat the Step 4 checks, then use the complete Step 5 `replace` command. Do not edit `approval.yml` or `public_manifest.csv`. |

For other problems, see [Troubleshoot the workflow](../../maintenance/troubleshooting.qmd).

:::
